text: A one-page website for Brew Lab, a small specialty coffee shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru. Visitors see the menu with prices, the opening hours and where to find the shop, and they can pre-order a coffee for pickup. Users: coffee lovers and office staff nearby. Problem: people cannot see the menu or order ahead. Must-have: menu with prices, pre-order form, map or address, opening hours. Constraints: one page only, works on phones, no payment. Success: 30 pre-orders per week.

@Requester To build the page I need a few real details from you. Please send them as exact as you want them shown.
Please send these: What items do you sell, and what is the price of each one (in rupees); Which days and what times is the shop open; What is the full street address of the shop in Indiranagar? Do you also want a phone number or email shown; When someone pre-orders, how should their order reach you.
